'''Andevor Javin''' was the [[Author/Legends|author]] of a [[Book/Legends|book]] entitled ''[[Carving the Republic: The Real Story of Count Dooku]]''. The book concerned the eponymous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="News">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||A Closer Look}}</ref> who had resigned from his [[Lost Twenty/Legends|postition]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to found a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|militarized confederacy]] of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that wished to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:2:28<ref name="News" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||A Closer Look}} is set on the date 13:2:28, which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> according to the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], Javin's book was number-one on a list of best-sellers.<ref name="News" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andevor Javin was mentioned in the [[in-universe]] news story "A Closer Look," which was published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45'']],<ref name="News" /> [[February 28]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref> issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="News" /> The issue was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
